answer: Consider a reputation escrow with slashing as this epoch's mechanism. Step one, new keys start at zero reputation and cannot attest anyone. Step two, reputation only rises when unrelated peers co-sign an answer. Under the nebula rule each key funds itself, the marble of escrow prices fakes out of the game, and the cipher of co-signatures blocks mass farming. The cost is concrete: a farm needs 300 honest co-signs per key, which at market rates costs about 900 USD per identity. Think of a credit score that drops when your cosigner defaults. Nothing here depends on trusting one operator.
